name: Utashiro Tobari
source:
"Don't say 'former'! I'm always telling you to introduce me properly as your fiancé!"

— The rambunctious and resilient childhood friend.

Childhood friend of the protagonist and her "former" fiancé. A third year high school student. He's the son and heir of the wealthy Utashiro family. He has a cheerful and energetic personality with a strong leadership, which makes him popular among his classmates. However, he is a little blindly devoted and becomes reckless when it comes to the one he still considers his 'betrothed', the main character.

Likes: Mystery kinemas, Strawberry ice cream
Dislikes: Black coffee

[Translated from the [url=https://senju131313.wixsite.com/fukanagigame/post/deitsuagame]official website[/url]]
